QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_29

question.text: The Code of Conduct for Social Impact Assessors typically covers which of the following pillars?

answer.text: Marketing ethics, client acquisition norms and referral-commission disclosures.
Integrity, objectivity, confidentiality, professional behaviour, professional competence and due care, documentation, due diligence and compliance.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.58 of the workbook, the SIA code focuses on integrity, objectivity, confidentiality, professional behaviour, professional competence and due care, documentation, due diligence and compliance. The Trap: Options A and B cherry-pick incomplete subsets of the code pillars. Option C imports unrelated marketing/referral-commission ethics that belong to a distributor-side code, not the SIA code. Note: The full list of code pillars on p.58 mirrors the ICAI Code of Ethics architecture, appropriate since the SRO sits under ICAI.
